title: Brewdog DogHouse Manchester Bar & Rooftop
address: 18-20 Fountain St, Manchester M2 2AR, United Kingdom

user_reviews.Name: Joaquim Agostinho
user_reviews.Description:
Went on a Wednesday for the ‘unlimited wings’ deal. We were there for 1 hour 30 minutes, but only got 4 servings of wings. On a past visit, in the same time, we got at least 6. Some of the wings brought out also didn’t match what we ordered.

When we mentioned this to staff, they apologised. They said a group of 10 at another table kept them busy, and that they’d run out of wings to serve. But the rest of the restaurant was quiet, so that didn’t really explain it. And if the deal is called ‘unlimited’, running out shouldn’t happen.

They offered us a free drink, but we were already leaving, so we didn’t take it. We still paid full price. Disappointing for what’s meant to be an ‘unlimited wings’ night.

user_reviews.Name: Leanne Smith
user_reviews.Description: We had a table booked last night for 7pm, it was very busy, no one came over to us at the door so we found our reserved table. We could see that there was a QR code on the table for ordering, so we attempted this but for some of us, it was saying the app you needed to download didn’t exist, so we asked if someone could come and take our order, thank god we did this and didn’t pay on the app before. Drinks never came over, we asked a staff member after half an hour and he said he would check on them. After 10 more minutes, he went and made them himself but came over to tell us he didn’t have one of the drinks we had ordered. We asked how long food would be and he said at least another half an hour. Like I said, it was busy. There’s a deal currently on so I understand that staff are rushed off their feet but where has common sense gone? Why are we only being told after 30 minutes, and after having to ask, that they don’t have one of the drinks we had ordered? And then even though the same server took our order, he never mentioned any wait on food at all, until we asked. From working in these jobs, it used to be common to tell tables that there’s a wait on food so they could decide whether to wait that long. But to sit there for 40 minutes in a bar without a drink is crazy. We did have a quick word with a staff member and a manager but just got, “it’s busy.” You clearly want everyone to order everything themselves on an app so that staff have less pressure on them, but if that’s the case, then teach the staff basic customer service.

user_reviews.Name: Pranav Bathla
user_reviews.Description:
The bar was boring if you want to get the english vibe, Cocktails were not good, they served me £14 cocktails in plastic glasses which was weird while also serving other customers in proper glass mugs.
Other bars in Manchester have a lot more character, don't waste your time with this one.

Decent collection of beer though

Hi Pranav,
Thank you for giving us your time to leave some feedback. 
We would like to explain that as part of our licensing conditions for showing the World Cup games, particularly the England fixtures, we had to use plastic glasses. We realise and accept your disappointment with this.

We hope you come back to give us another try!
Cheers, team DogHouse Manchester

user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie Kniveton-Jones
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely appalling visit here and ruined our night out. Booked a table for 4 of us for 7pm. Walked in and waited to be seated,  nobody approached us, although staff passed us several times.  No acknowledgement that we were stood there, no welcome or be with you soon.
My husband then started to walk around and found a reserved table with our name on, so after standing there for a while, we sat at the table.  We then proceeded to try and get the waiter's attention to order some drinks.  This was impossible,  waiting staff kept walking past our table with no eye contact,  no hello, be with you in a minute.  At 7.30..35 minutes after arriving, one of us got up and followed a waiter to ask if we could order,  his reply was what is your table number.  Told him and he came over 5 minutes later and took both our drinks and food order. At 8pm, a full hour after sitting down,  2 drinks arrived,  no food. The waiter said the beer tower that two of us ordered wasn't available and the food would be another half an hour!! Why didn't he tell us the drinks weren't available half an hour ago when we ordered,  so we could choose something else, not just bring 2 drinks for 4 people. No apology or anything. So, an hour waiting for drinks  and an hour and a half for food when we've booked a table for 7pm. Not good enough.  Don't take bookings if you can't fulfill and employ staff that actually give a damn about customers. The manager on duty last night (Friday 17th) , his answer to me complaining and leaving at 8pm was,  well we're busy. My advice is don't bother going here, I've never experienced such a couldn't care less attitude in a restaurant in my life.Take your hard earned money elsewhere.

user_reviews.Name: A J
user_reviews.Description:
Came for dinner last night as been hearing the hype about the food here so was looking forward to it .
My partner ordered the pit burger (where the main focal point is that it’s a pork loaded burger..) only to receive a plain cheese burger . When we asked it seemed the chef couldn’t be bothered to say there was no pork left and instead gave it us without , expecting us to be happy with that .
Not only that , the chicken wings were 99% batter , hard and crunchy to the point it hurt your mouth after a while because you’re biting through rocks, only to find a tiny slither of chicken on the bone - not impressed I left the majority of it on the plate !
The Korean chicken strips were just as bad , barely even chewable , thick hard batter only to be greeted with stale hard chicken on the inside that felt as though it had been reheated multiple times .
Considering the price £17 for a lone burger (have to pay extra for chips) and £23 for the platter … you’d expect amazing quality food . (Not to mention the £7 HALF pints..)
Wasted money expecting really good food.
Definitely not going to be coming here again

user_reviews.Name: Daniel Mason
user_reviews.Description:
This place is an absolute gem of a bar. The atmosphere and energy of it is magic.

Sat on roof terrace which is surrounded with lots of greenery. Super cool music and vibes. Love it. The bar and decor isn't a polished fancy bar. It is real, authentic muso bar. The icing on the cake is the wee food place on the roof terrace. This was a surprise to me as I didn't know it was there. Sipping a beer in the sunshine then glance over to see pizzas and snacks. A genuine Sicilian pizza kitchen. Oh my days - food was unbelievably good. Truly restaurant quality food served and presented almost festival style. For a moment we were transported to Glastonbury ( the music, the greenery, the beer, the food )

You cannot come to Manchester without visiting this place. One of favourites for sure.

Even visit just for the food. It really was incredible. Inexpensive yet very high quality.

I'm just hungry for more just typing this.

user_reviews.Name: Martin Dutton
user_reviews.Description:
This is a fantastic place to go if you want to sit outside with food and drinks and be up close and personal with the aeroplanes. We love coming here for a few hours, especially if we are flying from Manchester airport the next day.

Great day out for couples, friends and families.

Although we've had food here in the past, wd didn't have any on this visit, just drinks, but the food we did see looked very nice and the menu is good.

user_reviews.Name: Mike Naylor (Chief)
user_reviews.Description:
GOOD 👍
• The beer garden - it's big and right next to the runway. It also has a large covered area too.
• Staff are efficient and helpful.

BAD 👎
The car pack - it fills quickly and isn't cheap. (Although the attendants are helpful)

TIP ✔️
Go at a "quiter time" or park near the airport and make your own way in.

A must for anyone, not just plane spotters. We found that even those that "weren't even that bothered" were taking photos of the planes landing and taking off.

user_reviews.Name: Michael Collins
user_reviews.Description: Always wanted to visit this pub so today we were passing an thought why not give it a go. Not there is a parking charge here £2.00 for the 1st hour £3.70 for 2 hours which we paid so we didnt have to rush. Greeted by Sarah who was lovely didn't wait we was seated straight away. Orders we checked the menu and made our order 15 mins and they were bringing us the food. I had Steak and Ale pie, chips and peas plus gravy cost was £16.95 my thought was it wasn't very good value. Peas, gravy and chips were very small portion, The pie was OK pastry was good but very little in chunks of meat there was more minced steak in it however the taste was OK. My wife had chicken shack that came with fries, chicken wings with 1 dip sauce this was £15.95 also this was small with the wings being very small. The food was all cooked reasonably well however I couldn't recommend the Airport pub as the food is well over priced to what your getting hence we wouldn't return to uptake a dining experience here. At the rear of the Airport Pub there is an excellent viewing area where you can see the planes land and take off loads of seating plus on the a rainy day you can go into the Hanger where you can keep dry while watching the planes. All in all Service was 5 stars thankyou Sarah you were amazing. Food quality was fair but over priced to what you will get . For £2.00 to park and venture to the viewing area is really good value. Even if your going to have a drink which seemed to be priced more realistically.

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Hamilton
user_reviews.Description: After dinner out in Belfast and on way back to our hotel, we nipped into the Grand Central to check out the Observatory. Wow, we were certainly not disappointed! Towering 23 floors above the City Centre, directly overlooking the City Hall, the Observatory has the most fantastic Bird's Eye View of Belfast. A fantastic selection of drinks and cocktails awaits along with first class service and a relaxed atmosphere! We were escorted to a table by the window, prime position to take in the mesmerising views of the late night Belfast landscape and City Centre to watch the world go by. We ordered some cocktails which were excellent - highly recommend you try a Golden Mile! They are a little more expensive than other places but a great choice if you are looking a special date night for two or even just a catch up with friends, this will appeal to all and it's worth it for the panoramic 360° views across the City. I will definitely book to return here to try their food menu, perhaps a sunset dinner and evening cocktails! 🍹🍸

user_reviews.Name: Marc Bell
user_reviews.Description:
I was taken for a champagne afternoon tea here as a treat for my 40th birthday, expecting a polished, memorable experience befitting a five-star hotel. What I got instead was something that felt surprisingly disjointed, inattentive, and ultimately disappointing.

On arrival, we were greeted by the concierge and directed to a private lift, which suggested a strong first impression. Unfortunately, that’s where the sense of occasion ended. The staff member operating the lift engaged warmly with another couple while completely overlooking both myself and my mum... despite me wearing a very obvious birthday badge. It was a small moment, but it set the tone.

Upstairs, we were left standing at the entrance while other guests were seated. When we were finally acknowledged, we were led halfway into the room and pointed towards a small table at the back. No welcome, no explanation... just a gesture. We sat ourselves down.
Then… nothing.

After around 20 minutes without so much as a drink offer, it became clear we’d simply been forgotten. Other guests arriving after us were served almost immediately. It took a passing comment (admittedly not whispered) for a staff member to realise we were still waiting. Even then, we had to explain that we were there for afternoon tea.

The champagne, when it arrived, appeared to come from a resealed bottle and was completely flat within minutes. For something positioned as a premium experience, this was particularly poor.

The food didn’t recover things. The initial serving was minimal, followed by a stand that felt underwhelming in both quality and balance. The scones were clearly not fresh, the bread slightly stale, and while the desserts were plentiful, they were overwhelmingly sweet and lacked finesse. Even the coffee arrived lukewarm.

Throughout the entire visit, there was no acknowledgement of the occasion... no “happy birthday,” no attempt to add any personal touch... despite it being clearly visible.

To round things off, we were charged £132 for two people, including a 10% service charge, which felt difficult to justify given the level of service received. On leaving, there was no farewell, no thanks, and no assistance... just a long wait for a lift that stopped on multiple floors, a frustrating end to an already underwhelming experience.

For a venue that trades so heavily on its five-star status and skyline views, the experience felt more like an afterthought dressed up as something special.

I wouldn’t return, and I wouldn’t recommend it.

Cloud 23

The cocktails were beautiful and expertly crafted, making the experience and the city views well worth the visit. It is the perfect venue for celebrations or a special night out, and I will certainly be recommending Cloud 23 to others.

Thank you again for a memorable evening, and I look forward to visiting again soon.

Attended on a Monday afternoon and sampled the lunch menu at £35 for 3 courses with a £5 supplement for my rump steak and £6 for Skinny fries.

Brilliant location, great views, unfortunately there are only about 6 tables that have an uninterrupted view out over Manchester as they are in the window, the remainder sit behind and so on so if you want the view I'd suggest recommending a window seat.

If you are a group of more than 4, youll probably get a booth which is a very nice place to sit but furthest away from the windows.

If you're just having drinks, you sit on the other side of the restaurant and the majority of the tables (both inside and outside) have the desired view.

Additionally, make sure you go to the toilet because the view is great!

Onto the food, it was reasonably priced for Manchester and only very slightly more expensive than the equivalent 3 course Miller & Carter lunch menu for reference although you do have to pay extra for fries, vegetables & sauces etc so if you're not careful it could add up.

I did see the normal menu and I can confirm it is far more expensive so do keep that in mind.

The food was served fairly quickly and tasted great, my steak was cooked beautifully (medium) although it was lacking seasoning which I found odd given everything else was spot on, maybe they forgot or maybe its how it comes??

If I could give 4.5 stars, I would but I cant so the food must score 4 as my steak at Hawksmoor was better.

The cocktails we had were very nice although not the largest and quite expensive at £32 for the pair, so maybe consider just having a beer at £6.50.

Service was fine, very polite, attentive and they even gave my girlfriend a small plate with "Happy Birthday" written on it in chocolate letters and a small piece of chocolate cake with a candle on.

Overall, I had a very good experience and I would definitely recommend you try 20 stories for sure although I can imagine on a busy evening the price would be far higher, the wait for food a little longer and the atmosphere much louder.

None of these things are necessarily an issue provided you know the score!

user_reviews.Name: Multi Vitamins
user_reviews.Description:
20 Stories during our time in Manchester. It was truly an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by your hosting team. I would particularly like to commend Marina, who was incredibly friendly and attentive throughout the evening. She expertly guided us through the brand-new menu that had just launched and helped us select dishes that we absolutely loved. Her outstanding service made us feel truly at home.

The food itself was exceptional, and it is clear that the chefs put a great deal of passion and care into every dish; everything was beautifully presented and full of flavor. We also thoroughly enjoyed the atmosphere. The restaurant is stylish and spotlessly clean, and the views from the 20th floor over the Manchester skyline were simply stunning, especially around sunset.

While we noted it is an upscale experience, the combination of top-tier service, high-quality food, and the incredible setting made it 100% worth it. We left with amazing memories and will certainly be returning in the future.

On a final note, I did want to mention a point regarding the billing process. We found it a bit surprising that even when ordering through the app, a 13.5% non-discretionary service charge is applied to the final total. Given the digital nature of the ordering system, this felt somewhat inconsistent with the typical service model.

Thank you again for a wonderful evening, and I look forward to visiting you again soon.

title: Terrace NQ
address: 43 Thomas St, Manchester M4 1NA, United Kingdom
description: Guest beers & cocktails are served in this warehouse-style bar that has 3 leafy rooftop terraces.

user_reviews.Name: Mohammad Aghajani
user_reviews.Description:
Visited Terrace NQ with three friends and sat on the terrace at table 48, right next to the bar. The atmosphere was great, and the cocktails were enjoyable. The food was decent too – I’d give it 4/5.

Unfortunately, that’s where the positives ended.

When we arrived, our table was still covered with glasses from the previous guests. After waiting and seeing nobody deal with it, I ended up clearing them myself and placing them by the bar. Rather than receiving a simple thank you, I was met with a hostile look from a member of staff with black-and-yellow braided hair, as if I had done something wrong.

Our food arrived in takeaway containers, which felt strange for customers dining in. Whether that’s a cost-saving measure or not, it certainly doesn’t create the best dining experience.

The bigger issue was the service. No cutlery, napkins, or sauces were provided. I had to go and ask for them myself. The same staff member initially ignored me and only responded after I called over twice. Despite clearly seeing there were four of us, she handed me cutlery and napkins for only one person. The napkins themselves were dirty, and when I mentioned it, her response was, “That’s the best I can bring you.”

Not “let me get you a better one,” not “you can find more over there” – just “that’s the best I can do.”

To make matters worse, our table was next to the bar door, and staff repeatedly slammed it throughout the evening. Every few minutes we were startled by another bang. If the door doesn’t close properly, fix it. If it does, close it with some consideration for the guests sitting beside it.

Eventually we became so frustrated that we asked to move and sat downstairs outside instead. To be fair, the experience immediately improved. The two girls working behind the downstairs bar were friendly, welcoming, and genuinely helpful. They acknowledged us, had positive energy, and treated us the way hospitality staff should treat guests.

That’s actually what makes the contrast even more surprising. The problem clearly wasn’t the venue itself, and not every member of staff was an issue. Some of the team were excellent. Unfortunately, our experience upstairs was so poor that it completely overshadowed the rest of the evening.

I’ve worked in hospitality for years and currently help manage one of the busiest café groups in Manchester with multiple locations. Service standards matter, and unfortunately this was some of the worst customer service I’ve experienced in a long time.

Great location. Decent food. Excellent staff downstairs. Terrible service upstairs.

I won’t be returning, and I certainly wouldn’t recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Elisha Fray
user_reviews.Description:
I’m extremely disappointed with how I was treated at Terrace on the evening of 20th December.

When I reached the front of the queue and presented my ID, a member of the door staff wrongly accused me of being a woman who had been removed from the venue the previous week. This was completely untrue. Despite my calm attempts to explain the mistake, the accusation was repeated in front of other customers, which was incredibly embarrassing and upsetting.

While I understand that door staff have an important role in maintaining safety, the way this situation was handled was unnecessarily confrontational and humiliating. The bouncer’s tone became aggressive and disrespectful, and when it became clear that he was mistaken, I asked for an apology — which was refused.

I have been a regular customer at Terrace and have always enjoyed my visits in the past, which made this experience even more shocking. It completely ruined what should have been an enjoyable evening.

What is most disappointing is the lack of response since. I emailed the manager, Charlie, in December to formally raise this complaint and followed up again in January, but I have received no reply. A simple acknowledgement or apology would have gone a long way.

I hope this feedback is taken seriously and that steps are put in place to ensure situations like this are handled with more professionalism and respect in the future.

user_reviews.Name: J2785
user_reviews.Description:
I sought this place out after asking the internet where in Manchester does the best Bloody Mary, and SCHOFIELD'S kept coming up.
The internet was 100% correct.

My wife and I were greeted by the lovely Connor. He's cool, calm and collected and excellent at his job. We sat outside by choice on a very hot Saturday afternoon. It was consistently busy but never felt crowded or rushed. Any queues are quickly seated.
All of the staff work with such synchronicity and the guests inside and out seemed very well managed.
Even though it was busy, Connor still made time to chat to us and other guests, making us feel welcomed and valued rather than like cattle needing to be shooed off.
Out table water was refilled and refreshed without prompt, and my wife ordering a cocktail which wasn't on the menu was no problem.
It is on the expensive side but I would say you definitely get what you pay for and it would not put me off returning. In fact, I'll need to, because now I've been spoiled with The Best Bloody Mary ever ™️, others anywhere else just won't be good enough!

Thank you Connor and SCHOFIELD'S. Hopefully see you again.
Date of visit: July 2026

user_reviews.Name: Max Rose
user_reviews.Description:
Unicorn Grocery specialises in fresh, organic and locally sourced ingredients.

It’s clear from the moment you walk in that there is a clear goal in mind: environmental sustainability.

The decor is tactful and simple, and the shop is easy to navigate.

They have a range of fruit and veg (including a vast range of potatoes), cereals, seeds, nuts, cooking ingredients. as well as fresh deli items. They also sell a wide variety of soaps (e.g. full faith in nature range) and environmentally friendly cleaning products.

The zero-waste ethic is not only environmentally friendly but also allows you to save, with highly competitively priced items compared to supermarket equivalents in disposable packaging.

user_reviews.Name: Dorsa Milani
user_reviews.Description:
I absolutely loved this restaurant, and the moussaka was truly outstanding—without a doubt one of the best I've ever had.
The first time I ever tasted moussaka was when my dad made it for me. He used to own a restaurant in England and loved cooking dishes from different countries. Ever since then, moussaka has always held a special place in my heart.
I ordered it here because it reminds me of him. I live far away now, and I miss him so much. Eating this dish brought back so many beautiful memories of the moments we've shared together over the years. Thankfully, we still make new memories whenever we can. Thank you for serving such an authentic and delicious moussaka—it made this meal truly special.

This shop should really reflect on how they treat their employees and how that treatment impacts customers' experiences.

I came in today around 6pm getting 3 bottles of faith in nature product refilled. The shop is understaffed, leaving only one employee on the shopfloor running between the till where a queue is constantly forming and the refill station (because I had 3 bottles it was taking a while). At the same time the manager disappeared into the stockroom or sth for quite a long time despite the customers upstairs getting impatient and his support was urgently needed.

It is really unfair for the friendly, helpful and patient employee who served me to be under this stress and feeling bad that she was keeping people waiting.

Also, some of the big heavy refill bottles are kept on top of a very tall shelf, it is a safety concern and you really should provide your employees with a stool to reach them properly. The operation of getting the bottle looked precarious what if it slips and drops on someone's face?

I have used this shop to refill stuff for over a year, it is very convenient and I would like to support this store. However they should really improve their treatment towards employees. I read some reviews of this shop and it seems people have been reporting seeing staff looking unhappy. From my experience the ground staff have always been lovely but the management should perhaps look to themselves and think about how to improve.

If not for the lovely employee I met today this would've been a 2star review.

description: Supermarket chain selling groceries & household goods, with a focus on social responsibility.

user_reviews.Name: Aaron
user_reviews.Description:
This Co-Op Food is in a great location on High Street, opposite the Arndale, so it’s pretty central and convenient.

The selection is pretty good, and the checkouts move pretty quickly, so you can get in and out of here fairly quickly. Prices can be a little high, but no more than any other convenience store, and pretty average for the city centre. The prices can even work out value for money with some of their promotional offers through their loyalty scheme savings.

The meal deal section is particularly impressive with lots of options, although sadly, the only gluten-free sandwich is on seeded bread, which is a no-go for me.

I feel the accessibility of this store has got a lot worse over the past year or so. Aisles have become cluttered and narrower as they’re attempting to cram as much into the space as possible, and adding security gates, one way in, one way out, even the automatic doors seem to be set to only open halfway, this not only makes the shopping experience less pleasurable, but does bring to mind accessibility needs for those who need that extra space such as people with mobility aids, as they just don’t have it.

Overall, the location and selection are good, but the overall shopping experience is slowly getting worse, so this wouldn’t be my first choice in the city centre, but if passing through, the location is ideal, and I would return.

user_reviews.Name: Ed John
user_reviews.Description:
The range of foods is absolutely amazing, but there's a slight issue with customer service at the tills. My experience at the Tollcross store a couple months ago was strange - nobody else in the store and everything was scanned in a rush, no help with packing, and they seemed bothered by me asking if they did student discount and asking for my receipt after they chucked it in the bin.
Broughton is a bit better... a little less claustrophobic, but almost the exact same experience at the tills - again nobody behind me, and as soon as the transaction is done my receipt goes in the bin, and once they did that they walked away so I didn't know if I got a discount (according to their sign, it's 25% off bread after 6pm). I don't know if it's policy, or an assumption that customers don't want their receipt, but I prefer to go down the route of saying yes please or no thank you to a receipt instead of ensuring I intervene in the 0.5 seconds between payment and bin.

user_reviews.Name: Laura Holmes
user_reviews.Description:
5/5 Stars — Absolutely incredible experience for coeliacs!
I had the most amazing dining experience at Pranzo Manchester! As someone with coeliac disease, eating out can often feel stressful, but the team here made me feel completely safe and demonstrated a fantastic understanding of gluten-free needs from start to finish.
To top it off, I had the privilege of being their very first customer to try their brand-new gluten-free tiramisu, and it was an absolute 10/10!
A massive shoutout to Anna, our waitress, who was super attentive throughout the meal, and to the wonderful hostess (didn’t catch her name!) who truly made the whole experience special.
I can’t wait to come back again soon. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Tinnie
user_reviews.Description:
Overall, we has an enjoyable dining experience. Nice interior with an open kitchen, and we went for the lunch seasonal menu.

The standout for me was the green tomato gazpacho. It was incredibly refreshing, and the combination of tuna and salmon roe worked beautifully. The yellow pea fritter and baby courgette with goat’s curd were also very enjoyable. I really liked the starters overall, although I wish there had been just a slight hint of sweetness to balance the flavours.

For the main, the beef was excellent. It was cooked perfectly,tender, and paired wonderfully with the scallion. The dessert was a lovely way to finish the meal.

I also appreciated their commitment to sourcing quality ingredients from small local producers, which made the experience feel even more thoughtful.

My only minor criticism is that a few dishes were slightly on the salty side. Overall, it was a creative and well executed meal, and I’d happily recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Mete Onur
user_reviews.Description:
The daily changing menu and the use of seasonal ingredients immediately stand out. You can truly feel the attention to detail in everything, from the presentation of the dishes to the kindness of the staff.

I sat at the kitchen bar counter, on the side closer to the wines. At first, I thought I might get bored since I couldn’t fully see the kitchen, but there was such an incredible sense of order that even from my spot, there was always something going on to watch.

I ordered from the À La Carte menu. To start, I had the green pea and wild garlic fritters, and this was one of those dishes that really stayed with me. If it ever became a permanent item on the menu, I wouldn’t question it for a second. Alongside that, I chose a cheddar tart topped with watercress, which I also really enjoyed. The tart pastry, in particular, was excellent.

For the main course, I went with the egg pasta filled with caramelized onions and served with homemade ricotta. There wasn’t anything that particularly surprised me about this dish. It was good, but if I went again and saw it on the menu, I wouldn’t choose it again. On the side, I had a salad made with greens from their own farm, and its freshness was definitely worth mentioning.

For dessert, I chose the cane sugar ice cream and the custard tart. The custard tart is something I could easily eat every day without getting bored. As for the ice cream, I liked the presentation more than the taste. If I remember correctly, it was topped with apple caramel, and its flavor was quite dominant, which slightly overshadowed the ice cream itself.

I also had an americano, and the care put into the coffee really impressed me. I’ve had better coffee here than in places known primarily for their coffee.

It’s definitely a place I would visit again. You can really feel the level of care and effort that goes into everything. Thanks to the whole team.

I am absolutely thrilled with the outstanding service provided by Ryan and his team at the Nutritionist Manchester.
The twice-weekly delivery of healthy, chef-cooked meal preps has not only surpassed my expectations but has also made a significant positive impact on my overall health and well-being (I’ve lost 11kg since starting with them!!). The diverse range of flavors, meticulously balanced nutritional content, and the personalised touch tailored to my niche dietary needs truly highlight the expertise of the nutritionist. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone in search of a convenient and nutritious solution to meal planning.

Hats off to Ryan and the team for making healthy eating effortlessly enjoyable! Attached is an image of a recent Nutritionist MCR meal I had at my desk, exemplifying their ability to transform microwaved chargrilled halloumi into a fresh-off-the-BBQ delight.

Nutritionist MCR is a must-try for anyone embarking on a health journey without compromising on taste and wholesomeness.

Kudos for Ryan and his team for making healthy eating so easy and enjoyable! Keep up the exceptional work! - Mike T

user_reviews.Name: Nathan
user_reviews.Description:
So. Feeling a little mischievous this weekend I decided to order a meatball marinara with *everything* through JustEat. Every available extra option was selected out of sheer curiosity and honest willingness to test what these brave workers would do when confronted with such a beastly sandwich.

What ended up being delivered? I received a very nice note first, apologising for all the toppings not fitting onto a singular footlong bread loaf, but this did not disappoint.

The sandwich itself was beautiful, made with care and attention, the toppings selected from the vast amount of different meats I had provided on my order and layered to create a absolute delicacy. It was, to say, bloody gorgeous.

As for the rest of the toppings, I received sauces in pots on the side, an extremely nice side salad which frankly I'm going to need later for fear of my heart stopping soon and a box filled with the rest of the toppings that would not have gone nicely on the sandwich they had so carefully crafted.

The entire order was delivered hot (minus the salad) as well as fresh and I would highly recommend this subway.

Cheers to the staff for putting up with my order! I hope you had as much fun crafting the sammich as I have had fighting it down and rest assured I won't be doing this again for a while. :3

Ps. The note you sent is pinned on my wall where it will remain as a trophy!

user_reviews.Name: GWM Records
user_reviews.Description:
I am writing to raise a complaint
regarding the unacceptable service my daughter and I received at your Subway location.

Upon entering the store, the door slammed into my daughter, and rather than offering assistance or expressing concern, two male staff members began laughing at her in full view of other customers. This was both humiliating and completely inappropriate.

When we attempted to order a toasted cheese and onion baguette, a request we have made many times at other Subway branches, one of the staff members, whose name badge read “Kristen,” dismissively stated, “We don’t do that.” When I explained that we have ordered this exact item many times before, he acted as though he didn’t understand, forcing me to explain in detail how it’s usually made. His attitude throughout was mocking and unhelpful.

I then asked for a cappuccino, to which he responded, “We only do black coffee,” again while laughing with his colleague. This behavior was incredibly unprofessional and made us feel belittled and unwelcome.

When we finally received the baguette, it was of extremely poor quality, with barely any cheese and only a minimal amount of onion. As shown in the attached photo, the sandwich was clearly made with little care or effort.

user_reviews.Name: Aaron
user_reviews.Description:
This is a very good Subway location and one of my favourites in town right now, in the Arndale Food Court. The gluten-free selection is growing, including bread and jacket potatoes, with staff being trained on dealing with allergens and willing to wipe everything down as needed to reduce cross-contamination.

Service is fast and friendly, and my go-to order right now — a jacket potato with butter, salt, pepper, cheese, tuna mayo, sweetcorn, and red onion — is made to a good standard.

It can be busy sometimes, and I do feel cautious coming here during peak times, but the sandwich artists usually try their best.

Pricing is reasonable and in line with any other Subway, with my potato costing £6.19. If planning to use the Subway Rewards app, I’d say to have it ready ahead of time, as it can sometimes have issues when in the food court..

user_reviews.Name: Ralph Fitz-Patrick
user_reviews.Description:
recently visited this Subway location and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience that fell far below even basic customer service expectations.

When I arrived, there were two members of staff present behind the counter. Despite there being customers waiting (myself and one other person), both employees appeared far more interested in watching a video on a mobile phone than actually doing their jobs. They were standing together, focused on the screen, and made no immediate effort to acknowledge us or begin taking orders.

To make matters worse, every single table in the seating area was dirty, which immediately gave a poor impression of the overall cleanliness and management of the store.

After an uncomfortable wait, one of the staff members reluctantly stepped away from the phone to serve me, but it was clear their attention was still divided. During the process, they continued interacting with their colleague, who remained on the phone, and at times spoke to each other in Hindi. While I understand staff may communicate in different languages, in this context it felt unprofessional, especially as it was happening while customers were being kept waiting and service was already delayed.

The situation became even more frustrating during the preparation of my food. My sub was placed in the toaster, but instead of continuing with the order, the staff member walked away again to try and coax their colleague into helping, leaving my sandwich unattended and open. By the time they returned to complete it, it had gone noticeably cold, which completely defeats the purpose of having it toasted in the first place.

To make matters worse, I was in a rush and didn’t have the time to ask for it to be remade or go through the hassle of correcting the order, so I had no choice but to take it as it was.

Meanwhile, the other customer waiting was also being ignored. He had clearly stated his order, but the staff member either wasn’t paying attention or couldn’t hear properly, possibly due to having an AirPod in their ear while working. This led to confusion, delays, and a generally frustrating experience for everyone involved.

Overall, the service was extremely poor. There was a clear lack of professionalism, attention to customers, and basic workplace standards. Staff seemed disengaged, distracted, and unwilling to prioritise serving customers in a timely and respectful manner. Waiting customers were effectively treated as an inconvenience rather than the reason the business operates.

This experience has definitely put me off returning to this location. I would strongly recommend that management address staff behaviour, enforce stricter policies around phone use during shifts, improve cleanliness standards, and ensure that customers are treated with the attention and respect they deserve.

user_reviews.Name: Mohamed Gasim
user_reviews.Description:
I am writing to submit a formal complaint regarding an unacceptable and unprofessional incident that occurred at your Wilmslow Road branch in Manchester, which falls well below the customer service standards expected from a brand such as Subway.

We are regular customers of this particular branch and visit it consistently on a weekly basis to have our breakfast and dine in. During our most recent visit, we requested to use the restroom to wash our hands. We were informed by a member of staff that the restroom was “not available.”

However, shortly afterwards, we clearly saw the same staff member exiting the restroom. When we questioned this, we were told that the restroom is “for staff only.”

We would like to formally highlight the following concerns:
•	There is no visible signage in the restaurant indicating that the restroom is restricted to staff only.
•	Denying customers access to restroom facilities, especially for handwashing, is contrary to basic hygiene and public health standards, particularly in a dine-in food establishment.
•	It is unreasonable and unacceptable to expect customers to eat inside the restaurant without allowing them access to water and restroom facilities.
•	The manner in which this situation was handled was rude and dismissive, leaving us feeling disrespected despite being loyal, regular customers.

This experience caused us significant discomfort and disappointment, and it negatively affected our perception of this branch. Incidents of this nature risk driving loyal customers away, which is unfortunate given how frequently we visit this location.

We respectfully request that this matter be investigated, that the restroom usage policy at this branch be clarified, and that appropriate action be taken to ensure staff treat customers with professionalism, respect, and courtesy at all times.

We would appreciate a response at your earliest convenience.

user_reviews.Name: Aaron
user_reviews.Description:
Subway at Manchester Fort is in a rather small unit, tucked away towards the back of the retail park. The interior is old-school Subway. I do feel a refit and potential relocation would be a good option in the future.

There are a small number of tables inside to sit in with your food, and a number of parking spaces directly outside, including disabled parking, so it’s pretty easy to get in and out quickly.

I went for a jacket potato with tuna, cheese and some salad. I wasn’t overly pleased with the way the potato was put together; it looked like they’d just thrown the toppings on without a care. The vegetables didn’t look in the best shape either; the tomatoes looked old and dried out, so I didn’t opt for them on this occasion. I feel the preparation area could have been cleaner, and more effort could have been made to clean things down after making them aware of my needs.

There was a slight miscommunication in the ordering. I mentioned to the sandwich artist that I had a gluten intolerance, and he mistakenly thought I’d ordered the gluten-free bread, which required intervention from the other staff member to clarify things.

I’m not sure if I’d return to this particular Subway location at this time.

user_reviews.Name: Aaron
user_reviews.Description:
Subway on Portland Street is in a prime location within Manchester city centre, a short walk away from Piccadilly and Oxford Road, right by the Novotel. The interior is large and has a good amount of tables; it has the classic Subway look, so it could do with a refit in the future to follow the newer store look.

The opening hours are pretty good; they’re generally open well into the evening, and in 2025, they were open on Christmas Day, which is when I visited. I ordered my usual Jacket Potato with tuna and cheese. The sandwich artist was friendly and changed his gloves for me to reduce cross-contamination after letting him know I was gluten-free. Mohi delivered excellent service from start to finish.

Food quality was good, everything tasted fresh and was made with care

It’s pretty good value for money here too - the prices seem to be lower than other Subway locations in the city centre, with my jacket potato costing £5.59 on this occasion, in the Arndale, I’d pay at least £6.19.

I look forward to returning to this Subway location in the future.

user_reviews.Name: Belovede Akuru
user_reviews.Description:
I visited this Subway on 24/06/2026 and was served by the man shown in the attached photo. I have visited this branch before, prior to the introduction of the self-service ordering system, so I approached the counter as usual. I am quite particular about how I like my sandwich prepared, so I typically order the footlong bread, meat  and cheese, first on the kiosk, then politely direct staff regarding the salad and toppings. I have never experienced any issues doing this at any Subway location before.

From the beginning of the interaction, this staff member was unnecessarily rude and confrontational. I was polite throughout, using “please” and “thank you” as I always do. I appreciate that the recent hot weather in Manchester may make working conditions more difficult, but that does not justify treating customers in this manner. While preparing my sandwich, he handled it so roughly that it started falling apart. He also refused to add the sauce I requested, claiming I would have to pay extra for it, which I have never been asked to do at any Subway branch before.

After my order was completed, I calmly asked for his name because I intended to raise a complaint regarding his conduct. He refused to provide it and immediately became more aggressive, shouting at me and claiming that I was banned from the store. This is when I took my phone out to take a picture instead to report him since he refused to give me his name. He then began following recording me out the store.

The staff member repeatedly raised his voice and caused a scene to the point where other customers and member of the public commented on his behaviour, with one person even stating that it was “out of order” and urged me to report him to Subway.

I then spoke to another member of staff, who was extremely polite and professional. She kindly agreed to remake my sandwich and did so without any issue. During this time, the original staff member continued shouting at me, telling me to leave the store and swearing at me. He then stormed out of the shop and, when I later exited, I could see him outside on the phone shouting about me & then again started shouting at me when I walked past him.

I have been a Subway customer for many years and have never experienced treatment like this before. The behaviour displayed was unprofessional, intimidating, and completely unacceptable. I would appreciate this matter being investigated and addressed appropriately.

I would also like to make it clear that throughout the entire interaction, I remained calm and respectful. At no point did I swear, raise my voice, or behave aggressively towards the staff member. Despite this, he repeatedly raised his voice at me, shouted across the store, and used inappropriate language. I made every effort to handle the situation politely and reasonably, which makes his behaviour even more disappointing and unacceptable.

title: Caldo Lounge
address: 2A Waterside, Sale M33 7BS, United Kingdom

user_reviews.Name: Aaron
user_reviews.Description:
Caldo Lounge in Sale is located on Waterside, in the town centre, I really like the look and feel of this particular Lounge, it looks cute from the outside with the nice patio area, with the regular vibes that I’m used to from the Lounge inside, with a varied selection of seating including tables more suited to relax with coffee, grab some food and bar-style seating too.

As with any in the Loungers chain, the gluten-free selection is extensive, and prices are reasonable. Unlike some Lounges, the gluten-free menus are kept behind the bar, I actually like this approach better as it means you can have a conversation with the staff, and feel assured about allergies straight away, and there's no chance of menus going missing on tables.

I’ve visited here a couple of times now, and the food standard has always been good; they always seem to do a very good job with the poached eggs here and make sure all items of the Breakfast are hot and cooked well, which is hard to do. My favourite dishes are the Louisiana Fried Chicken with Chipotle Mayo and the GF Lounge Breakfast, swapping the bacon for an extra sausage.

The staff are friendly, and service is usually pretty good, although on my most recent visit, there was some confusion, potentially caused by me ordering at the counter due to my allergy, and the rest of my party ordering via the QR code, as the ordered drinks took a while to come, and the pots of tea were super weak when they did finally arrive, with both the teas and their cutlery arriving after their food had arrived.

After a further good experience here with great quality food and service, and a much-appreciated clarification regarding the gluten-free menus being kept behind the bar, I feel Caldo deserves a full five stars as it's one of my favourite lounges. The tapas offer on a Tuesday is awesome with 3 tapas dishes and a glass of wine for £13.75 - it's worth a trip for!
